In our conversation, you refused to allow the Appellant to provide a release of the OWCP records to the Merit Systems Protection Board (\'93MSPB\'94 or \'93Board\'94). As discussed, the Postal Service cannot release OWCP\rquote 
s records as part of the Agency File absent the return of the executed release. Your refusal to release the records for inclusion in the Agency File to the MSPB is interfering with the Postal Service\rquote 
s compliance obligations in the Acknowledgment Order, and prejudicing its ability to d
efend the Appeal. If I do not receive a signed release within five (5) business days, the Postal Service will file a motion asking for the Appeal to be dismissed with prejudice. .
